string.text: Box containing a belt with capacity for 200 5.56x45 rounds. The M249 is a common sight at Freedom foreposts, providing a high volume of suppressive fire against Monolith encroachers.
Heavy box that holds 200 rounds of 7.62x54R ammunition in a belt, for use with the PKM. It is advised to bring a few of these if you plan on hunting Pseudogiants or Chimeras.
